thread:
oncall-bot: PAGER: service dl-runner experiencing repeated container restarts in namespace serve-prod. crashloops on 4 pods across nodes gpu-21,gpu-22. Auto-pager to #incidents.
oncall-bot: Severity: sev2 · Affected customers: small subset of quant-int8 tenants (~3%). Pager key=dl-runner-crash-2219998888
zoe: Im taking primary. pinging runtime and infra. Can someone drop the failing pod logs?
mika: grabbing logs now. `kubectl logs dl-runner-7c9f4 --previous -n serve-prod` shows SIGSEGV in fastmatmul.so. Pasting snippet: 
```
[signal SIGSEGV: segmentation violation]
0x7f2c8c1b4d90 in fastmatmul::packed_gemm<Int8,AVX2>::kernel() at fastmatmul.cpp:412
vllm::Engine::run_step() at engine.cc:934
```
raj_sre: checking node-level output. dmesg on gpu-22 shows: `NVRM: Xid 31: Uncorrectable ECC error`. Also see kubelet restarting container repeatedly. Might be memory alignment issue hitting older drivers on gpu-21/gpu-22.
tanya_runtime: this image `rwd/dl-runner:int8-fast-v5` was rolled to prod in yesterday's scheduled push. We added an int8 packing path that assumes 16-byte alignment for rows. If shapes aren't padded, older GPUs with strict alignment might fault.
zoe: timeline: first alerts at 10:18 PDT. Customers reported 5xxs around 10:20. Which tenants hit? Luke?
luke_prod: one enterprise tenant using int8 policy hit failing generations. Non-int8 models unaffected. CS already notified.
sophie_cs: confirmed: customer ticket INC-7893 created. They reported timeouts/500s for ~10 minutes. Asking for ETA.
tanya_runtime: mitigation suggestion: 1) set env OVERRIDE_INT8_PACK=1 to force safe (unpadded) codepath 2) rollback image to `rwd/dl-runner:stable-2.1` for affected node pool 3) cordon problem nodes to prevent further scheduling of int8-fast pods.
raj_sre: cordoning gpu-21,gpu-22 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-21 && kubectl cordon gpu-22`
raj_sre: draining gpu-22 to move pods off suspected nodes: `kubectl drain gpu-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
tanya_runtime: applying deployment patch to add `OVERRIDE_INT8_PACK=1` and image -> `rwd/dl-runner:stable-2.1`. Starting rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1.
deploy-bot: rolling update started for deployment/dl-runner -> image rwd/dl-runner:stable-2.1 (initiated by tanya_runtime)
mika: collecting core and gdb backtrace from one remaining failing pod before it gets evicted. gdb bt (sanitized):
```
#0  0x00007f2c8c1b4d90 in fastmatmul::packed_gemm<Int8, AVX2>::kernel() at fastmatmul.cpp:412
#1  0x000055bb9a8c3eaa in vllm::Engine::run_step at engine.cc:934
#2  0x000055bb9a8f4b33 in server_loop at server.cc:721
```
mika: local analysis: code tries to load 32-byte aligned block with `vmovdqa` when cols % 16 != 0. On older architectures this causes crash instead of graceful partial read.
zoe: Good catch. Is rollback observing reduction in restarts?
raj_sre: after cordon/drain and rolling update, restarts dropped to 0 on previously impacted nodes. Service errors returned to baseline.
deploy-bot: rolling update completed for deployment/dl-runner -> rwd/dl-runner:stable-2.1 (duration 7m)
luke_prod: Customer notified: we rolled back the int8-fast image and applied a safe override. Asking them to validate; theyre testing now.
sophie_cs: Customer reports generation success and no further 5xxs. They appreciate the quick rollback and want a postmortem.
zoe: Root cause hypothesis: int8 packing optimization assumed 16-byte alignment/padding; when sequences produced matrix widths not aligned to vector width, code executed aligned load instructions causing illegal access on certain GPU/CPU combos -> SIGSEGV in native kernel.
tanya_runtime: short-term: keep `OVERRIDE_INT8_PACK=1` in prod and avoid auto-promotion of `int8-fast` builds to prod until we add safe alignment checks. I'll open RUNTIME-1401 and assign to runtime team to add padding guards + unit test for odd widths. Also will add a canary gate to prevent int8-fast from landing on mixed-driver node pools.
raj_sre: recommending a post-incident action: add node label check in admission controller to prevent scheduled pods that require accelerated intrinsics on old drivers. Filing infra issue INFRA-902.
zoe: On-call handoff: Ill leave notes for next shift. If anything reoccurs, escalate to on-call lead.
luke_prod: Thank you. Customer wants an ETA on permanent fix; will ask runtime to update by EOD.
sophie_cs: updating customer ticket with rollback details and our follow-ups.
zoe: Closing pager once we confirm no new restarts for 30m. Current impact summary: ~3% customers using int8-fast experienced failures for ~12m; mitigation: rollback to stable image and applied OVERRIDE_INT8_PACK=1; root cause: alignment assumption in int8 packing causing segfault on certain nodes. Follow-ups: RUNTIME-1401 (pad/guard), INFRA-902 (node scheduling guard), test additions, and canary policy change. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident closed (auto): incident=dl-runner-crash-2219998888 closed by zoe at 2219999150
